info.title: Neon Self-hosted Control API
info.description: Implemented self-hosted control API. M2 creation is enabled only when capability discovery reports its driver ready; unsupported SaaS Backend services remain disabled.

bearerToken.description: Expiry, revocation, current membership and key permission ceiling checked on every request.

backendCredential.description: Branch-scoped ncb_ application credential with ai_gateway:invoke. Console cookies and control API keys are not accepted.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: Required for cookie-authenticated mutations. Bearer-authenticated requests do not use cookie CSRF.

role.name: role
role.description: URL-encoded PostgreSQL role identifier, at most 63 UTF-8 bytes.

resourceVersion.name: If-Match
resourceVersion.description: Quoted current resource version. Retried observations never replay this mutation.

runtime.description: Observed workload state. Managed VM observations include workload_uid and workload_created_at for generation-scoped idle evidence; absent/unknown observations cannot qualify for automatic suspension.

endpoint_type.description: Read-only computes share branch storage and can be created multiple times.

AutoscalingBounds.description: Historical integer profiles remain supported. Fractional preview uses verified 250m/1Gi compute units, only 250/500/750m within the laboratory 3Gi ceiling. New VM immutable capacity must include requested range. Logical CPU budget differs from QEMU overcommit cgroup quota; not strict guest CPU isolation. Fractional creation rejects dummy/skip-cgroup runners before publishing the Endpoint; an owned writable cgroup host mount is required.

parent_timestamp.description: RFC3339 historical time, mutually exclusive with parent_lsn. Requires pitr_new_branch; only retained, replayed history is accepted.

parent_lsn.description: Retained WAL point, mutually exclusive with parent_timestamp. A distinct branch is created; existing Endpoints are unchanged.

password.description: Required only for read_write; forbidden for read_only.

CreateEndpoint.description: type defaults to read_write. A writer requires a new password; a read_only endpoint must omit password and reuses the branch writer role verifier.

password.description: Only for new local accounts (12-256 characters). Existing accounts must omit or send empty password; this does not reset a shared account.

project_id.description: Only on organization endpoint; must belong to that organization. Empty means organization scope.

token.description: Only returned once. ncp_ prefix, cryptographically random. Server stores only SHA256 digest.

jwks.description: Static public RS256/EdDSA keys only; private parameters rejected

expires_at.description: Required expiry, between one minute and 30 days; enforced by the verifier

api_token.description: Returned once on the first create/rotate response, never in durable replay or list. Lost response requires rotation.

token_id.description: S3 access key ID, present for storage-scoped initial issue/rotation only.

s3_secret_access_key.description: S3 secret returned once only. Never persisted in replay or returned by metadata GET.

items.description: Exact trusted browser origin; no wildcard, credentials, path, query or fragment.

require_email_verification.description: Optional policy. Requires operator SMTP. False is omitted from the canonical spec to retain old idempotency hashes. Changing policy requires normal disable/re-enable and a new identity generation.

email_otp_enabled.description: Opt-in branch email OTP login/signup, verification and password recovery using the configured operator transport; requires immutable runtime regeneration.

magic_link_enabled.description: Opt-in maintained Better Auth Magic Link; requires operator SMTP.

magic_link_allow_registration.description: Explicitly permits verified email link signup.

two_factor_enabled.description: Allow maintained TOTP/password-login MFA enrollment and one-use recovery codes for application accounts; distinct from Console administrator MFA

mail_operator_enabled.description: Operator configuration / observed owned runtime mount respectively; does not certify SMTP delivery or production TLS.

mail_runtime_enabled.description: Operator configuration / observed owned runtime mount respectively; does not certify SMTP delivery or production TLS.

confirm_selector.description: Exact current Endpoint Selector, not the branch name

invocation_url.description: No public Functions origin admitted in this release.

version_token.description: Exact bigint version; send quoted in If-Match rather than rounding through JavaScript number.

environment_names.description: Names only. No values or Secret refs.

source_deployment_id.description: Immutable completed original deployment in the exact same Function/project/branch; null for ordinary deploy/resume.

path.description: Application-relative path, starting with /. No dot segments or backslashes.

zip.description: Validated ZIP containing index.mjs, at most 8 MiB. Required without retained source. Omit to reuse the exact previous completed source, or first failed source only after acknowledged stop completed for the current generation and every candidate retired.

environment.description: JSON string dictionary patch; at most 32 names. Omit or {} retains the eligible original immutable environment. Nonempty value sets the name; empty value removes that name. Values never read back.

max_tokens.description: Also bounded by the selected approved route.

name.description: 1–100 UTF-8 bytes after trim; no CR/LF/NUL.

sql.description: Draft text <=64 KiB UTF-8. Stored encrypted; never executed by this API.
Included only in an authorized detail read, never in mutation/replay/list.

202.description: Queued operation

patch.description: Queues an idempotent autoscaling soft-bounds update. Reconciliation validates endpoint ownership and immutable NeonVM capacity, persists the Proxy cold-wake template with Secret resourceVersion compare-and-swap, then patches the live VM with UID/resourceVersion checks and verifies the resume template before committing endpoint metadata. Suspended endpoints update their resume template without waking compute. A live VM whose current allocation exceeds the requested maximum rejects the operation; the requested bounds must fit its immutable hard min/max. Partial external failure marks the Operation failed/retryable rather than committing success, and retry converges the same desired bounds. Connection fencing and cross-instance lifecycle races remain an independent production gate.

delete.description: Editor/Admin only. A quoted current endpoint version, stable Idempotency-Key and exact selector confirmation are required. Ready managed endpoint and no active project Operation; dependent Data API/Auth/Object Storage services must be disabled first. Admission closes synchronously. A leased Worker closes only this Proxy route using resourceVersion CAS, deletes the owned NeonVM using UID/resourceVersion preconditions, waits for Runner garbage collection, then persists a retained endpoint tombstone. No timeline, role, database, blob, credential Secret or other endpoint is deleted. Replaying the original request returns the same Operation even after deletion; retry uses the original failed Operation. A replacement endpoint has a new selector and reuses branch SQL credentials. This is not physical data GC or distributed connection fencing.

post.summary: Execute SQL through Neon Proxy

role.description: Optional public role. Defaults to endpoint role; protected internal identities rejected.

database.description: Optional database. Defaults to endpoint database.

X-Neon-SQL-History-ID.description: Present when optional history admission was durably recorded; identifies this request record, never a replay token.

X-Neon-SQL-History-State.description: Completion-record state; unconfirmed means SQL may have completed while metadata finish could not be confirmed. Do not replay SQL based on this header.

422.description: Invalid input, database authentication or PostgreSQL query error; retryable=false.

502.description: Database TLS certificate verification failed; retryable=false.

503.description: Database connection unavailable. retryable=true only before user SQL was sent.

504.description: Connection or query budget exceeded. retryable=true only before user SQL was sent; otherwise verify the outcome before retrying.

403.description: CSRF validation or global write-role validation failed.

post.description: Executes SQL through Neon Proxy with a 180-second total budget. The connection and cold-wake budget defaults to 120 seconds and is configured server-side with NEON_SQL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (5-150 seconds). Query statement_timeout is 120 seconds, additionally bounded by the remaining total budget. Error responses include a request_id correlated to redacted structured logs. A timeout or connection loss after SQL was sent can have an unknown outcome: retryable=false, so clients must verify the outcome before retrying writes. SQL is never automatically retried by this gateway. During connection setup the fixed Proxy can encode password authentication failures and cold-wake internal failures as XX000. The gateway recognizes the documented password authentication prefix only during connect and returns 422 with retryable=false; other internal connection failures return 503 before user SQL is submitted. Raw PostgreSQL messages are never exposed or logged.

patch.description: Editor/Admin and CSRF; Idempotency-Key plus numeric If-Match catalog version_token. Only ready API-owned non-system databases with non-system managed owners on the same branch are eligible. Original PostgreSQL OID, branch ownership marker and old owner are captured before admission and checked by the Worker. Atomic branch/parent/role/version checks queue the existing catalog pipeline; real ALTER DATABASE OWNER, all Compute configuration Secrets, route verification and final metadata CAS are required. No data/table/schema ownership/ACL is rewritten, no connection is terminated and no privilege grants or superuser bypass are introduced. Same-key replay returns the original Operation after completion; unknown outcomes are observed by original OID/marker/old-or-final owner, never adopted by name alone. Default/system-owned databases, rename, arbitrary external DDL and distributed fencing remain separate gates.

Only a suspended definition with all original instances retired and a completed retained deployment is eligible. Replaying the same key/body/version returns the original Operation even after completion; deployment requests have a separate fingerprint domain. post.description: Authorized Editor/Admin with public role/password, same Proxy selector and TLS policy as single SQL. PostgreSQL simple protocol parses the complete supplied script, including semicolons in comments/quoted strings/dollar bodies. No client-side splitting, injected BEGIN/COMMIT or automatic replay. Maximum input 32000 bytes; retain 16 result sets, 64 columns/set, 200 total rows and 1 MiB encoded cell JSON; still drain subsequent commands without dropping execution intent. Eight MiB wire message body cap; submitted transport/decode failure returns 503 sql_script_outcome_unknown with retryable=false. SQL statement errors return HTTP 200 outcome=failed with sanitized SQLSTATE and bounded preceding results. Earlier explicit COMMITs may be durable; never claim the whole script rolled back. Unclosed transactions are marked and rolled back on connection close. int8 values outside JavaScript safe integer range and non-finite floats are strings. Audit contains actor/endpoint/outcome only, no script/password.

post.summary: Restore an owned completed Function deployment
post.description: Explicit asynchronous new deployment/generation/boot from selected completed source belonging to the exact Function/project/branch. Requires fully retired suspended original Function, Editor/Admin, CSRF, Idempotency-Key and numeric If-Match. Rejects code/environment overrides. Verifies retained environment UID/MAC/key version and blob digest before admission and rechecks locked parents/version/retirement/pending Operations/source in one transaction. Persists immutable source_deployment_id; audit action rollback_function; existing deploy_function Worker pipeline. Same key/body/version returns original Operation after completion. Cross-route/source key conflicts reject. Does not restore database data, replay customer invocation or resurrect process RAM. Current form contents are ignored.
